t1.name: Minh Anh
t1.quote: I practice for 15 minutes every night, and after a month, my reflex in answering Japanese interviews is significantly faster. The pronunciation assessment is detailed down to every single word.

t2.name: Quoc Bao
t2.quote: The custom question drafting feature fits my work perfectly — practicing real project meeting scenarios with Japanese clients.

t3.name: Thu Ha
t3.quote: Thanks to Furigana and Vietnamese translations, a beginner like me can still confidently practice speaking without being afraid of making mistakes.

q1.question: Does NaHo support correcting Honorifics (Keigo)?
q1.answer: Yes. The AI analyzes Keigo structures in corporate contexts, points out errors in using Sonkeigo / Kenjougo / Teineigo, and suggests appropriate expressions for each communication scenario.

q2.question: Can N5/N4 levels practice on the platform?
q2.answer: Yes. The system supports toggling Furigana on all Kanji characters and instant translations, helping beginners confidently practice conversations.

q3.question: Who is this application designed for?
q3.answer: NaHo is designed for Bridge Software Engineer (BrSE) students at FPT University and Japanese learners in the IT field, especially those who need to practice Kaiwa reflexes for interviews and Japanese office environments.
